mapper.sql: SELECT id, version, name, kind, risk_level, mcp_server_id, mcp_tool_name, http_method, http_url, http_timeout_ms, input_schema::text, param_policies::text, description, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, published_at FROM cap_tool_def
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_tool_def (id, version, name, kind, risk_level, mcp_server_id, mcp_tool_name, http_method, http_url, http_timeout_ms, input_schema, param_policies, namespace, description, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, updated_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{version}, #{name}, #{kind}, #{riskLevel}, #{mcpServerId}, #{mcpToolName}, #{httpMethod}, #{httpUrl}, #{httpTimeoutMs}, #{inputSchema}::jsonb, #{paramPolicies}::jsonb, 'platform', #{description}, #{configFingerprint}, #{schemaVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{publishedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id, version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WHERE id = #{id} AND published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND mcp_tool_name = #{mcpToolName} AND published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, version, name, kind, risk_level, mcp_server_id, mcp_tool_name, http_method, http_url, http_timeout_ms, input_schema::text, param_policies::text, description, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, published_at FROM cap_tool_def ORDER BY id, version DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (mcp_tool_name) id, version, name, kind, risk_level, mcp_server_id, mcp_tool_name, http_method, http_url, http_timeout_ms, input_schema::text, param_policies::text, description, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, published_at FROM cap_tool_def WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} ORDER BY mcp_tool_name, version DESC
